Overview
DAILY STARTING POINT

What this is: Overview is the first scan of event health: registrations, guests, money recorded, capacity, and attention items.

Why you use it: Use it to decide where to work next instead of opening every page manually.

What to do now: Read the metric row and choose the highest-priority Needs Attention item.

What happens next: The destination link sends you to the page that owns the follow-up.

Practical example: If missing tickets appear, go to Tickets before event-day check-in starts.

Verified: Verify the Overview metrics are visible.
